Section 1. [+BECKER; WATER TREATMENT FACILITY IMPROVEMENTS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

This appropriation also includes money for construction of well pump facilities and related infrastructure. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $1,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for water treatment facility improvements in the city of Becker; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BECKER; WATER TREATMENT FACILITY IMPROVEMENTS.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$1,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Becker for acquisition of land and for predesign of a new municipal water treatment facility. This appropriation also includes money for construction of well pump facilities and related infrastructure.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $1,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $1,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Becker for acquisition of land and for predesign of a new municipal water treatment facility. This appropriation also includes money for construction of well pump facilities and related infrastructure.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $1,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
